classification: anonymized aggregate real-world API workload mapped to deployed R054 curve
privacy: aggregate only; no prompts, message text, user ids, session ids, hosts or IP addresses included
method: For each historical interactive session, average prompt tokens per API call were mapped by piecewise-linear interpolation onto the measured deployed-profile context/decode curve. Session results were then weighted by call count or historical generated-token count. Prefix caching is intentionally excluded from decode-rate interpolation because it primarily changes prefill/TTFT.
